Title: Drawing out the Beast and Terror Frenzy

Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
What happens when both these cards are used on the same vampire? (Terror
Frenzy at normal, DotB at either.) Terror Frenzy reads, "...[opposing
minion] can only use maneuvers to set the combat at long range, can only use
presses to end combat..." DotB reads, "...[opposing vampire] can only use
maneuvers to cancel maneuvers, can only use preses to continue combat..."

Would the vampire subjected to both these cards be unable to use *any*
maneuvers or presses?

--
Justin Fang (jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Justin Fang wrote:
>
> What happens when both these cards are used on the same vampire? (Terror
> Frenzy at normal, DotB at either.) Terror Frenzy reads, "...[opposing
> minion] can only use maneuvers to set the combat at long range, can only use
> presses to end combat..." DotB reads, "...[opposing vampire] can only use
> maneuvers to cancel maneuvers, can only use preses to continue combat..."
>
> Would the vampire subjected to both these cards be unable to use *any*
> maneuvers or presses?

Yes, since he cannot maneuver to close (TF) nor long (DotB), and
he cannot press to continue (TF) nor end (DotB).
